_: DNAS bypass for the US PSU discs: the single source for every form of it.
DNAS only, no other behaviour change.
Consumed by extract/bypass.py, which builds all three forms from this file:
iso    a prepatched disc image (plus an .xdelta of it for people who want to patch their own)
cheats Cheat Device PS2, original disc on a FreeMcBoot console
The game code is not in the boot ELF but in ERX/PSU_US.GZ: a gzip of a relocatable EE module
(based at 0, REL relocations). The disc form therefore gunzips it, patches the words AND drops
the R_MIPS_26 relocation on each patched word (otherwise the loader adds the load base to our
replacement and turns `move v0, zero` into garbage), then re-deflates it to EXACTLY the original
size so no LBA on the disc moves. The runtime forms write after relocation and need load_base.
'va' is a module address (pre-relocation, == file .text address). 'expect' is the retail word in
the file. The four sites are the DNAS object's calls into the DNAS library: the status poll
becomes a branch to the game's own 'operation complete' path, the three operation starts return

module.load_base_note: measured from a savestate (extract/p2s.py find): 99 clean windows agree, same on a second boot

hook.note: scePad2Read in the boot ELF's libpad2 (export table 0x1bae48, entry 12). $ra is saved at 0x1b1498; this word and the next are plain moves/stores, safe to back up and re-run

SLUS-21631.title: Phantasy Star Universe: Ambition of the Illuminus (USA)

module.load_base_note: measured over PINE on the retail disc (PCSX2): the four sites hold their R_MIPS_26-relocated jal at this base and 234/235 sampled plain .text words match. A near-identical DNAS function 0x180 earlier also matches a short unrelocated pattern at 0x23cc80; the relocated jal rules that out
